== Strategy ==

Some basic strategy.  Control cloud city with the troopers.  Drains are pretty good with pucumir and ur opponent CANT modify or cancel them when the objective is flipped.  With lobot, m’tok, and edian the troopers are power +1 (another one at the core), forfeit +2, deploy for free, and get plenty of added battle destiny.  Rebel ambush adds power as well and makes them immune to attrition.  And blast the door kid gets rid of all characters with ability greater than 2, which lets me lay a beating on all their smaller characters.  Shawn valdez is real nice when iv already layed all my troopers down; I can drop him at an adjacent site where my opponent is and bring them over for a beating.

Card selections: cc celebration=retrieval     civil disorder=forces my opponent to deploy or makes him pay     bargaining table=cancel drains

Lift tube escape=find my tubes, or escape from a bad battle or even put another card in my life force before I finish him off

responses: revelation, thanx for the rating.  i agree cc troopers rnt all that great, but lobot and friends make them worth it

shewski, i do have lando w/gun in u musta missed him.  ur probably right about the blast the door kids;  i just keep on salivating at the thought of a TDIGWATT, or CF deck that combines mains and like ugnaughts
